title: 연구학교에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1

Article 7 (Support for Operating Expenses)
The Superintendent of Education may, within budgetary limits, provide a research school with necessary operating expenses, including expenses for purchasing teaching materials, teaching tools, and books needed for research; expenses for developing and producing educational materials; and printing expenses. Provided, however, that the Minister of Education may, within budgetary limits, provide necessary operating expenses to permanent research schools or research schools designated and operated under Article 4 (5) and (6). [Amended on January 31, 2001; March 4, 2008; July 30, 2008; and March 23, 2013.]
